text:
Megan (arch): Quick follow-up from RFC review — we need a practical plan to soft-deprecate the legacy `instructions` param on /chat.generate without breaking existing clients. Thoughts?
Ryan (eng-platform): Agree we should avoid a hard cut. Proposal: gateway-level shim that maps `instructions` -> prepended system message, with an opt-in strict header for customers who want exact semantics.
Megan (arch): That matches what I had in mind. Key tradeoffs:
- Pros: immediate compatibility, low customer friction
- Cons: hidden behaviour, harder to test server-side quality regressions
Sam (infra): Operational concerns: shim increases payload work at the edge and can complicate caching. We should gate via feature-flag per-tenant and route only on tenants hitting the older SDK UA.
Lia (devex): We need clear telemetry so we can tell which prompts were transformed. Suggest adding `x-rw-compat-mode: instructions-shim-v1` header on requests we mutate, and surface that in Console.
cheng (eng-runtime): Implementation sketch: gateway detects `instructions` in JSON body, removes it, prepends to `messages` as system role, and sets header `x-rw-compat-applied: instructions-v1`. Pseudocode:
```json
{
  "messages": [ { "role": "system", "content": "<instructions value>" }, ... ]
}
```
Megan (arch): Good. Also: provide a strict-compat opt-out header for clients who want to preserve `instructions` as a separate semantic (for a while). Something like `x-rw-strict-instructions: true` -> gateway must reject mutation and forward original body.
Ryan (eng-platform): Rollout plan idea:
1) Implement shim behind tenant FF, default ON for tenants with UA matches and new installs OFF
2) Canary 5% traffic for 48h with metrics on latency, token-count delta, and model quality regressions (eval set)
3) If regressions, flip FF and surface advisory docs
4) After 30d, announce planned long-term deprecation and open a gradual sunset period
Sam (infra): Add circuit-breaker: if transformed requests exceed X% errors or add >Y ms p50 latency at gateway, auto-disable shim for that tenant. We already have infra hooks to toggle FFs via signal.
Lia (devex): Docs + SDKs: add warning in SDK when `instructions` present, recommend migration to `messages` + system. Provide script to transform offline. Also add migration telemetry: `compat.instructions.migrated` event.
cheng (eng-runtime): Tests: unit for mapping, integration to ensure streaming still works (key for memory/kvcache). Edge-case: very long `instructions` should be chunked into multiple system messages or rejected with clear error. Need limit policy.
Megan (arch): Good call on long inputs. Policy: reject > 8k chars with 400 + migration hint for now.
Ryan (eng-platform): Security/compliance: preserved PII policies should apply; ensure KMS tags and PII scrubbing run before/after mapping consistently. Also make sure we log minimal metadata for telemetry.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: gateway-canary/compat-instructions-v1 -> 2026-03-22T02:00Z (canary).
Megan (arch): Next steps: Ryan to draft FF lifecycle and telemetry keys; cheng to open runtime PR with mapping + tests; Sam to add circuit-breaker thresholds; Lia to draft SDK warning and migration script. We'll reconvene after canary results. :thumbsup:
Ryan (eng-platform): Will do. I'll include sample header examples for Console queries.
Lia (devex): I'll add migration snippet to repo `devx/migrations/instructions-to-system.md`.
cheng (eng-runtime): Starting PR today. Expect unit tests + streaming test.
Sam (infra): I'll pick conservative thresholds: error >= 2% or p50 increase >= 60ms -> auto-disable.
Megan (arch): Thanks all. If anyone thinks strict-compat header name sucks, speak now or file an issue. :thinking:
